synthesis:draft.headline: SA1 RRP peaked at $4981.0 at 16:35 UTC (2026-07-31 02:05 ACST)
summary: Peak regional reference price (RRP) in SA1 was $4981.0 (evidence_id: ev0436) at 16:35 UTC (2026-07-31 02:05 ACST).
Dispatch TotalDemand at the peak interval was 1472.82 MW (evidence_id: ev0437).
Net interchange at the peak interval was -82.59 MW (net flow into SA1 / import) (evidence_id: ev0438).
Unweighted mean RRP across the window was $416.71/MWh (evidence_id: ev0886).
The finder identified 214 five-minute intervals at-or-above the analysis threshold (evidence_id: ev0002). The analysis threshold reported in the timeline is $300.0/MWh (evidence_id: ev0888).

AEMO operational demand (30-minute values) around the event: interval end 16:30 UTC operational demand 1509.0 MW (evidence_id: ev0912); interval end 16:00 UTC operational demand 1547.0 MW (evidence_id: ev0911); interval end 17:00 UTC operational demand 1466.0 MW (evidence_id: ev0913). The operational demand series peak shown in the returned data is 2173.0 MW (evidence_id: ev0898).

SCADA-observed unit-level changes include BARKIPS +146.18 MW (evidence_id: ev0940), AGLHAL +64.45 MW (evidence_id: ev0943), and BLYTHB −60.06 MW (evidence_id: ev0946). (These are descriptive SCADA observations from the generation change tool.)
AEMO market notices retrieved include statements about a City West transformer/circuit trip and Forecast LOR conditions in the days prior (see published_findings and citations).
Weather context (Adelaide point): WS50M wind speed max 3.5 m/s (evidence_id: ev1009); T2M min 4.73 °C (evidence_id: ev0984) and max 14.01 °C (evidence_id: ev0991).

numeric_claims.text: Dispatch TotalDemand 1472.82 MW at peak interval
WS50M wind speed max 3.5 m/s (Adelaide point)

possible_explanations.statement: The price spike might be associated with tight local supply relative to demand; AEMO had issued Forecast LOR notices on 29/07/2026 which could be related [c2][c3].
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Fetch unit availability/outage records, the five‑minute bid stack/offers for the peak interval, and any reserve/availability declarations for 30 July to see if available capacity was constrained relative to demand.

possible_explanations.statement: The price spike might be related to changes in net interchange or interconnector capability; the timeline shows net interchange = -82.59 MW (net import) at the peak (evidence_id ev0438).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Obtain interconnector availability, dispatch constraint notices, and interconnector flow limits and compare to actual flows and any changes in those limits around the peak interval.

possible_explanations.statement: The spike might coincide with notable SCADA-observed unit dispatch changes (for example BARKIPS +146.18 MW, AGLHAL +64.45 MW, BLYTHB −60.06 MW) which could reflect rapid changes in local dispatch patterns.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Align unit-level dispatch logs, outage declarations, and bid/offer changes with the five‑minute prices to see whether these units' bid prices or availability align with the interval that set price.

possible_explanations.statement: The documented City West transformer/circuit trip might have affected network capability and operations (AEMO reported a City West transformer trip [c1]).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Fetch network constraint/dispatch advice and any AEMO follow-up incident reports describing operational network capability changes after that non-credible contingency to check for sustained effects on dispatch or constraints.

citations.supports: Reports a non-credible contingency event in SA (City West transformer and breaker trip described in the notice).

citations.quote: PDPASA - Forecast Lack Of Reserve Level 1 (LOR1) in the SA Region on 29/07/2026.
citations.supports: Reports a Forecast LOR1 condition in SA on 29/07/2026.

citations.supports: Reports a Forecast LOR2 condition in SA on 29/07/2026.

uncertainties: The generation_change tool returns SCADA snapshots and changes but does not by itself indicate bidding intent, offers, or formal outage declarations.
No five‑minute DISPATCHPRICE revision history, DISPATCHPRICE ROP/APC flags, or unit-level offer/bid stacks were returned; without them we cannot identify which bid(s) set the RRP.
Market notices retrieved include the transformer trip and LOR forecasts, but the notice texts alone do not establish timing or mechanism linking those notices to the 16:35 UTC interval.
missing_evidence: Five‑minute DISPATCHPRICE revision records and DISPATCH_PRICE_REVISION entries for the peak interval to see if price overrides or revisions occurred.
Unit-level bid/offer stacks and outage/availability records for units in SA around 2026-07-30T16:35:00Z.
Interconnector availability, constraint notices, and dispatch constraint equations for the SA region for the day to assess network-driven pricing.
FCAS activation and settlement details for the peak intervals.
AEMO post-event incident or power system event reports that could connect the City West transformer trip to subsequent operational effects.
